name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Kanban board for teams with projects, cards, attachments and real-time updates, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with the DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL (or DEFAULT_ADMIN_USERNAME) and DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD values from the environment. This admin is re-applied from the environment on every start, so change its password there; it cannot be edited or deleted in the UI while DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL is set.
